verdict.rationale: Customer.io has a code editor for emails, a Design Studio API in its published OpenAPI spec, and a CLI that scripts the full API, so templates could plausibly be managed programmatically. The transactional API also accepts data to populate message variables such as reset URLs. However, nothing documents a templates-as-code or version-control workflow, and one developer built an alternative specifically to get code-defined templates. Missing for 10: explicit HTML/MJML template import and export via API, a documented variable/templating language, git or version-control integration for templates, and hands-on corroboration of a code-managed template workflow.
